0022600016.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-4, 12th in the East, three games back in the Central) head to Boston (3-1, second in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back) on a three-game losing streak against a Celtics team riding three straight wins, in Emirates NBA Cup East Group C play. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Tobe Awaka is day-to-day with an ankle injury, while Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness). The Bulls trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 134-99 loss in Boston on October 26, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
